_meta.note: Constants that are NOT in the game's defines.lua: found by fitting the 80 fixture saves, then recorded here with their evidence. calc.py reads them through game_data.const() like any define; change only with a new research result and a verified stage.
_meta.FIXED_POINT_SCALE: the game computes and stores values in 3-decimal fixed point with truncation: val 83,201/83,201, power_fraction 42,323/42,330, share_total 42,330/42,330 (README integration log)
_meta.TRANSFER_FRACTION: docs/research/R04 + project check: t_out = trunc3(0.5 * (val - 0.1)) in 1,855/1,855 entries
_meta.TRANSFER_MIN_POWER_KEPT: same check: val - 2 * t_out is between 0.100 and 0.101 for every giver; origin of the 0.1 unexplained
_meta.TRANSFER_FRACTION_FULL: docs/research/R04 response_1 V-R04-1 (Venice series U07-U30, 2026-10-05): the plain vassals AVR (of GAZ) and LDU (of MRA) transfer t_out = trunc3(1.0 * (val - 0.1)); every giver of the 80-save corpus used 0.5. What sets the fraction is open (R04 request_2), so calc identifies each giver's fraction from the recorded t_out (identify_observed)
_meta.STEERING_BONUS_RANKS: docs/research/R08 + project check 2026-10-09 (205 clean saves): on each steered link the steerers ranked by effective power x steering strength get add = trunc3(strength / rank) for rank 1..5 and no `add` after that; the per-link sum of `add` matches in 18,184 of 19,086 links (the rest: strengths off by an unread trade_steering source, ties)

TRANSFER_FRACTION.comment: share of (val - TRANSFER_MIN_POWER_KEPT) a subject transfers to its overlord

TRANSFER_MIN_POWER_KEPT.comment: subtracted from val before the transfer fraction is applied

TRANSFER_FRACTION_FULL.comment: second observed transfer fraction (plain vassals AVR, LDU); identified per giver from its recorded t_out

STEERING_BONUS_RANKS.comment: number of steering merchants per link that get the steering value bonus `add`
